scope: gene-rule corrections found while tracing the carbon-source conditions on which the drafts fail to grow (cycle 6, scripts/condition_gapfill.py): genes that the condition-specific fitness data and the RefSeq annotation place in a catabolic pathway but that the draft had assigned to a different reaction (R1 removal there, R4/R6 assignment here). R6 (new): assign an annotated gene to a reaction the draft carries without a gene. Same verifier as v0.2/v0.3: status 'accepted' unless the fitness data contradict the change.

patches.note: the draft's gene SM_b21581 is a 'glycosyltransferase family 4 protein'; SMc03111 (SM_RS15275, pmi, 'mannose-6-phosphate isomerase Pmi') is the strongest mannose-specific fitness gene (-7.3) and was absent from the draft
SMc02875 (SM_RS01030, 'N-acetylglucosamine kinase', nag cluster) added next to the ROK-family kinase SMc02880 the draft had

glmS is SO4741; SO3506 is nagB-II (glucosamine-6-phosphate deaminase, now on G6PDA)
the draft carries N-acetylglucosamine kinase without a gene; SO3507 (SO_RS16395, nagK, 'N-acetylglucosamine kinase') is a GlcNAc-specific fitness gene (-6.1)
